title: Representable functor
description: JSON Schema for a representable functor — a functor F : C^op → Set that is naturally isomorphic to a hom-functor Hom_C(-, A) for some object A (Mac Lane 1971 Ch. III §2; Awodey 2010 §8.4). Specializes functor by carrying a representing-object cell. Representability is the structural property at the heart of the Yoneda lemma.

representing-object.description: The object A such that this functor is naturally isomorphic to Hom_C(-, A). The natural isomorphism witnesses representability.
